raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

NVFP4 host-cache transfers must preserve packed K/V bytes together with their persistent scale buffers. Generic token-scale MHA descriptors and logical-head-width staging do not represent this layout correctly. This is the independent transport companion to the workspace fix in [#43356](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43356).

## Modifications

- Add an explicit NVFP4 buffer descriptor and host-pool dispatch, using byte-width geometry for packed payload transfers.
- Back up and restore page-granular scale buffers with target/draft layer order preserved, and include persistent scales in host allocation accounting.
- Support aligned whole-page L2 transfers with the `kernel` backend and `page_first` layout. Reject invalid descriptors, partial transfers, native-only scale layouts and unsupported relocation/L3 layouts. Token indices retain canonical order within each page.

Descriptors also carry optional native-layout scales when present; this branch has CPU coverage. Native-only configurations remain explicitly unsupported.

## Accuracy Tests

Independent validation of this **6-file patch**, based on `a99c7d050fae`:

- **26 registered CPU tests passed** for descriptors, allocation, transfer selection and rejection checks.
- **96 GPU byte comparisons passed** for page sizes 16/32/64 with permuted source, host and reload pages.
- **32 additional comparisons passed** for a 65-page transfer crossing the 64-page staging capacity.

The GPU cases use two target and two draft layers on RTX 5090/SM120, comparing packed K/V plus token-linear K/V scales. Native scale buffers are disabled/rejected in these GPU cases. They establish byte preservation; native-scale GPU transport, SM100 and RTX PRO 6000 were not validated.

```bash
python -m pytest -q \
  test/registered/unit/mem_cache/test_nvfp4_host_buffer_info.py \
  test/registered/unit/mem_cache/test_nvfp4_mha_pool_host_unit.py
```

The **combined workspace + HiCache candidate**, using Qwen3.8-27B ModelOpt NVFP4 on TP2 RTX 5090, additionally passed **8 L2 Graph/eager request pairs**. Its finite 24-item quality comparison scored **19/24 for both NVFP4 and FP8 with zero new errors**. These combined results are separate from this patch's standalone transport tests and do not establish standalone end-to-end quality or the full reasoning/tool/vision/needle suite.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

No standalone host-transfer throughput claim is made. The complete five-point ABBA and memory/capacity measurements are reported in the [companion core PR](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43356), with HiCache enabled for both paths.

For that **combined candidate**, NVFP4/FP8 paired request-throughput ratios were 1.0573/1.0110/0.8809/0.9012/0.8832 for shared 25K C1/C4/C16, shared 50K C4 and unique 25K C4 respectively. At an equal 196608-token pool, ready-state known KV/scales/workspace storage was 31.99% lower and PyTorch allocated memory 4.97% lower per rank. Separately measured automatic token-pool capacity was 782,592 vs 565,568 (+38.37%). These service and capacity results are not attributed to the HiCache transport patch alone; the core's launch optimization does not change this patch.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

The repository-pinned `pre-commit` stage passed on all six changed files. This result is retained for the byte-identical HiCache patch; it was not rerun for the core launch optimization.

+"""HiCache L2 for NVFP4 payload bytes and both persistent scale layouts.
+
+The device description carries token-linear scales and, when allocated, native
+page/head/token scales. Payload copies reuse the ordinary MHA host pool with
+byte-width geometry; scales travel through page-granular side buffers. Target
+and draft buffers share the same packed local layer order as their payloads.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Sequence
+
+import msgspec
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.kvcache.hicache import (
+    can_use_write_back_jit_kernel,
+)
+from sglang.kernels.ops.kvcache.hicache import (
+    transfer_hicache_all_layer_mla_staged_lf_pf as jit_transfer_hicache_all_layer_mla_staged_lf_pf,
+)
+from sglang.kernels.ops.kvcache.hicache import (
+    transfer_hicache_one_layer_mla as jit_transfer_hicache_one_layer_mla,
+)
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.device_pool_info import (
+    KVBufferLayout,
+    KVScaleLayout,
+    MHABufferInfo,
+)
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.pool_host.common import (
+    ALLOC_MEMORY_FUNCS,
+    _cuda_host_unregister,
+)
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.pool_host.mha import (
+    MHATokenToKVPoolHost,
+    _is_cuda,
+    _is_hip,
+)
+
+
+def nvfp4_payload_info(info: MHABufferInfo) -> MHABufferInfo:
+    """Describe existing packed bytes without copying or allocating tensors."""
+    info.validate()
+    if info.scales is None or info.scales.layout != KVScaleLayout.NVFP4:
+        raise ValueError("NVFP4 host transfers require an explicit NVFP4 scale layout")
+    if info.head_dim != info.v_head_dim or info.head_dim % 16:
+        raise NotImplementedError(
+            "NVFP4 host transfers require equal K/V head dimensions divisible by 16"
+        )
+    if info.dtype != torch.uint8 or info.buffers.layout != KVBufferLayout.NHD:
+        raise NotImplementedError(
+            "NVFP4 host transfers require packed uint8 NHD buffers"
+        )
+    if info.transfer_buffers is not None:
+        raise NotImplementedError(
+            "NVFP4 host transfers do not support relocatable buffers"
+        )
+    token_capacity = info.buffers.k[0].shape[0] if info.buffers.k else None
+    for side in (info.buffers.k, info.buffers.v):
+        for buffer in side:
+            if (
+                buffer.ndim != 3
+                or buffer.shape[0] != token_capacity
+                or tuple(buffer.shape[1:]) != (info.head_num, info.head_dim // 2)
+                or buffer.shape[0] % info.page_size
+                or not buffer.is_contiguous()
+            ):
+                raise ValueError(
+                    "NVFP4 payload must contain contiguous, page-aligned "
+                    "[token, head, packed_dim] byte rows"
+                )
+    # The underlying tensors and pointer tables stay exactly the same. Removing
+    # scales here is deliberate: this descriptor is only for the payload copy;
+    # the subclass separately retains and transfers every scale allocation.
+    return msgspec.structs.replace(
+        info, head_dim=info.head_dim // 2, v_head_dim=info.v_head_dim // 2, scales=None
+    )
+
+
+def _scale_buffers(info: MHABufferInfo):
+    scales = info.scales
+    result = [
+        ("k_scale_buffer", False, scales.k),
+        ("v_scale_buffer", False, scales.v),
+    ]
+    if scales.native_k or scales.native_v:
+        result.extend(
+            [
+                ("native_k_scale_buffer", True, scales.native_k),
+                ("native_v_scale_buffer", True, scales.native_v),
+            ]
+        )
+    return result
+
+
+class MHATokenToKVPoolFP4Host(MHATokenToKVPoolHost):
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        buffer_info: MHABufferInfo,
+        host_to_device_ratio: float,
+        host_size: int,
+        page_size: int,
+        layout: str,
+        pin_memory: bool = True,
+        device: str = "cpu",
+        allocator_type: str = "default",
+        *,
+        device_capacity_tokens: int,
+        start_layer: int,
+        end_layer: int,
+        draft_buffer_infos: Sequence[MHABufferInfo] = (),
+        write_back_staging: tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor] | None = None,
+        pool_label: str = "kv",
+        head_group_num: int = 1,
+        host_token_capacity: int | None = None,
+    ):
+        if layout != "page_first":
+            raise NotImplementedError("NVFP4 host transfers support only page_first")
+        infos = (buffer_info, *draft_buffer_infos)
+        payload_infos = tuple(nvfp4_payload_info(info) for info in infos)
+        if not buffer_info.buffers.k:
+            raise NotImplementedError(
+                "NVFP4 host pool requires at least one target layer"
+            )
+        if any(info.page_size != page_size for info in infos):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "NVFP4 target, drafts and host must use the same page size"
+            )
+        if any(len(info.buffers.k) != 1 for info in draft_buffer_infos):
+            raise ValueError("NVFP4 packed draft descriptions must contain one layer")
+
+        self._scale_names = []
+        self._scale_page_bytes = {}
+        kinds = _scale_buffers(buffer_info)
+        expected_names = {name for name, _, _ in kinds}
+        for info in infos:
+            if {name for name, _, _ in _scale_buffers(info)} != expected_names:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    "NVFP4 target and drafts must carry the same scale layouts"
+                )
+        for name, rows_are_pages, _ in kinds:
+            buffers = []
+            page_bytes = page_size * buffer_info.head_num * buffer_info.head_dim // 16
+            for info in infos:
+                selected = dict((n, b) for n, _, b in _scale_buffers(info))[name]
+                for payload, scale in zip(info.buffers.k, selected):
+                    expected_shape = (
+                        (
+                            payload.shape[0] // page_size,
+                            info.head_num,
+                            page_size,
+                            info.head_dim // 16,
+                        )
+                        if rows_are_pages
+                        else (payload.shape[0], info.head_num, info.head_dim // 16)
+                    )
+                    if (
+                        tuple(scale.shape) != expected_shape
+                        or scale.element_size() != 1
+                        or scale.device != info.device
+                        or not scale.is_contiguous()
+                    ):
+                        raise ValueError(
+                            f"NVFP4 {name} has invalid shape, dtype, device or strides"
+                        )
+                    buffers.append(scale)
+            self._scale_names.append(name)
+            self._scale_page_bytes[name] = page_bytes
+            setattr(self, f"_scale_dev_{name}", buffers)
+            setattr(self, f"_scale_host_{name}", None)
+
+        if not all(
+            can_use_write_back_jit_kernel(element_size=n)
+            for n in self._scale_page_bytes.values()
+        ):
+            raise NotImplementedError(
+                "NVFP4 scale pages require the staged JIT transfer kernel"
+            )
+        super().__init__(
+            payload_infos[0],
+            host_to_device_ratio,
+            host_size,
+            page_size,
+            layout,
+            pin_memory,
+            device,
+            allocator_type,
+            device_capacity_tokens=device_capacity_tokens,
+            start_layer=start_layer,
+            end_layer=end_layer,
+            draft_buffer_infos=payload_infos[1:],
+            write_back_staging=write_back_staging,
+            pool_label=pool_label,
+            head_group_num=head_group_num,
+            host_token_capacity=host_token_capacity,
+        )
+        if not self.can_use_jit or not self.can_use_write_back_jit:
+            raise NotImplementedError(
+                "NVFP4 host pool requires staged JIT kernels (CUDA/HIP, io_backend='kernel')"
+            )
+        self._init_scale_buffers()
+
+    def get_size_per_token(self):
+        payload = super().get_size_per_token()
+        scales = sum(self._scale_page_bytes.values()) // self.page_size
+        return payload + scales * self.layer_num
+
+    def _init_scale_buffers(self):
+        alloc_func = ALLOC_MEMORY_FUNCS[self._transfer_device.type]
+        for name in self._scale_names:
+            page_bytes = self._scale_page_bytes[name]
+            host = alloc_func(
+                (self.page_num, self.layer_num, page_bytes),
+                dtype=torch.uint8,
+                device=self.device,
+                pin_memory=self.pin_memory,
+                allocator=self.allocator,
+            )
+            setattr(self, f"_scale_host_{name}", host)
+            setattr(self, f"_scale_host_layers_{name}", list(host.transpose(0, 1)))
+            rows = [
+                buffer.view(torch.uint8).reshape(-1, page_bytes)
+                for buffer in getattr(self, f"_scale_dev_{name}")
+            ]
+            setattr(self, f"_scale_rows_{name}", rows)
+            setattr(
+                self,
+                f"_scale_ptrs_{name}",
+                torch.tensor(
+                    [row.data_ptr() for row in rows],
+                    dtype=torch.uint64,
+                    device=self._transfer_device,
+                ),
+            )
+            setattr(
+                self,
+                f"_scale_staging_{name}",
+                torch.empty(
+                    (self.staging_page_capacity, self.layer_num, page_bytes),
+                    dtype=torch.uint8,
+                    device=self._transfer_device,
+                ),
+            )
+
+    def _validate_transfer(self, host_indices, device_indices, io_backend):
+        if io_backend != "kernel":
+            raise NotImplementedError(
+                "NVFP4 host transfers support only io_backend='kernel'"
+            )
+        if (
+            host_indices.ndim != 1
+            or device_indices.ndim != 1
+            or host_indices.numel() != device_indices.numel()
+            or device_indices.numel() % self.page_size
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "NVFP4 host transfers require matching whole-page index lists"
+            )
+
+    def _page_ids(self, indices):
+        # The allocator supplies canonical aligned pages in token order. Checking
+        # shape/count here catches partial transfers without a GPU-to-CPU sync;
+        # arbitrary within-page permutations are not a supported input contract.
+        return indices[:: self.page_size] // self.page_size
+
+    def backup_from_device_all_layer(
+        self, device_pool, host_indices, device_indices, io_backend
+    ):
+        self._validate_transfer(host_indices, device_indices, io_backend)
+        if device_indices.numel() == 0:
+            return
+        super().backup_from_device_all_layer(
+            device_pool, host_indices, device_indices, io_backend
+        )
+        device_pages, host_pages = (
+            self._page_ids(device_indices),
+            self._page_ids(host_indices),
+        )
+        if host_pages.is_cuda:
+            host_pages = host_pages.cpu()
+        for name in self._scale_names:
+            jit_transfer_hicache_all_layer_mla_staged_lf_pf(
+                ptr_src=getattr(self, f"_scale_ptrs_{name}"),
+                src_indices=device_pages,
+                dst_indices=host_pages,
+                staging=getattr(self, f"_scale_staging_{name}"),
+                dst=getattr(self, f"_scale_host_{name}"),
+                page_size=1,
+            )
+
+    def load_to_device_per_layer(
+        self,
+        device_pool,
+        host_indices,
+        device_indices,
+        layer_id,
+        io_backend,
+        *,
+        is_draft=False,
+    ):
+        self._validate_transfer(host_indices, device_indices, io_backend)
+        if device_indices.numel() == 0:
+            return
+        if not is_draft and not 0 <= layer_id < self.target_layer_num:
+            return
+        if is_draft and not self.target_layer_num <= layer_id < self.layer_num:
+            raise ValueError("NVFP4 draft layer must be a packed local draft index")
+        super().load_to_device_per_layer(
+            device_pool,
+            host_indices,
+            device_indices,
+            layer_id,
+            io_backend,
+            is_draft=is_draft,
+        )
+        device_pages, host_pages = (
+            self._page_ids(device_indices),
+            self._page_ids(host_indices),
+        )
+        for name in self._scale_names:
+            jit_transfer_hicache_one_layer_mla(
+                cache_dst=getattr(self, f"_scale_rows_{name}")[layer_id],
+                indices_dst=device_pages,
+                cache_src=getattr(self, f"_scale_host_layers_{name}")[layer_id],
+                indices_src=host_pages,
+                element_dim=self._scale_page_bytes[name],
+            )
+
+    def destroy(self):
+        for name in getattr(self, "_scale_names", ()):
+            host = getattr(self, f"_scale_host_{name}", None)
+            if host is not None and self.pin_memory and (_is_cuda or _is_hip):
+                _cuda_host_unregister(host)
+            for attr in ("host", "host_layers", "staging", "rows", "ptrs", "dev"):
+                setattr(self, f"_scale_{attr}_{name}", None)
+        super().destroy()
+
+    def _storage_pages_unsupported(self):
+        return NotImplementedError(
+            "NVFP4 host pool does not expose flat L3 pages: scales live separately"
+        )
+
+    def get_data_page(self, index, flat=True):
+        raise self._storage_pages_unsupported()
+
+    def get_dummy_flat_data_page(self):
+        raise self._storage_pages_unsupported()
+
+    def set_from_flat_data_page(self, index, data_page):
+        raise self._storage_pages_unsupported()
+
+    def get_page_buffer_meta(self, indices):
+        raise self._storage_pages_unsupported()
+
+    def get_split_heads_page_buffer_meta(self, indices, split_factor):
+        raise self._storage_pages_unsupported()

+"""Persistent NVFP4 scale descriptors must not silently drop a native layout."""
+
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.device_pool_info import KVScaleLayout
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.memory_pool import MHATokenToKVPool
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+def pool_fixture(recipe, *, linear, native):
+    pool = object.__new__(MHATokenToKVPool)
+    pool.quant_method = SimpleNamespace(name=recipe)
+    pool.k_scale_buffer = (
+        [torch.zeros(64, 2, 4, dtype=torch.uint8) for _ in range(2)] if linear else None
+    )
+    pool.v_scale_buffer = (
+        [torch.ones_like(buffer) for buffer in pool.k_scale_buffer] if linear else None
+    )
+    pool.native_k_scale_buffer = (
+        [torch.full((4, 2, 16, 4), 2, dtype=torch.uint8) for _ in range(2)]
+        if native
+        else None
+    )
+    pool.native_v_scale_buffer = (
+        [torch.full_like(buffer, 3) for buffer in pool.native_k_scale_buffer]
+        if native
+        else None
+    )
+    return pool
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("native", [False, True])
+def test_nvfp4_descriptor_retains_every_persistent_scale_allocation(native):
+    pool = pool_fixture("nvfp4", linear=True, native=native)
+    scales = pool._mha_scale_buffers()
+    assert scales.layout == KVScaleLayout.NVFP4
+    for exported, original in (
+        (scales.k, pool.k_scale_buffer),
+        (scales.v, pool.v_scale_buffer),
+        (scales.native_k, pool.native_k_scale_buffer or ()),
+        (scales.native_v, pool.native_v_scale_buffer or ()),
+    ):
+        assert len(exported) == len(original)
+        assert all(actual is expected for actual, expected in zip(exported, original))
+
+
+def test_nvfp4_native_only_cannot_silently_export_as_plain_uint8():
+    pool = pool_fixture("nvfp4", linear=False, native=True)
+    with pytest.raises(NotImplementedError, match="(?i)(linear|native)"):
+        pool._mha_scale_buffers()
+
+
+def test_unquantized_pool_without_scales_preserves_none():
+    pool = pool_fixture("unquantized", linear=False, native=False)
+    assert pool._mha_scale_buffers() is None
+
+
+def test_fp4_mx_keeps_existing_token_layout_without_nvfp4_dispatch():
+    pool = pool_fixture("fp4_mx_block16", linear=True, native=False)
+    scales = pool._mha_scale_buffers()
+    assert scales.layout == KVScaleLayout.TOKEN
+    assert scales.native_k == scales.native_v == ()
+    assert all(
+        actual is expected for actual, expected in zip(scales.k, pool.k_scale_buffer)
+    )

+"""NVFP4 host descriptors, packed staging and target/draft scale contracts."""
+
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import msgspec
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.device_pool_info import (
+    KVBufferLayout,
+    KVBuffers,
+    KVScaleBuffers,
+    KVScaleLayout,
+    MHABufferInfo,
+)
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.pool_host import mha, mha_fp4
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.pool_host.mha import MHATokenToKVPoolHost
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=10, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+def info(layers=2, native=True, page_size=16):
+    tokens, heads, dim = 64, 2, 64
+    k = tuple(
+        torch.zeros(tokens, heads, dim // 2, dtype=torch.uint8) for _ in range(layers)
+    )
+    v = tuple(torch.zeros_like(t) for t in k)
+    scales = lambda: tuple(
+        torch.ones(tokens, heads, dim // 16, dtype=torch.uint8) for _ in range(layers)
+    )
+    native_scales = lambda: tuple(
+        torch.ones(tokens // page_size, heads, page_size, dim // 16, dtype=torch.uint8)
+        for _ in range(layers)
+    )
+    return MHABufferInfo(
+        buffers=KVBuffers(
+            k=k,
+            v=v,
+            layout=KVBufferLayout.NHD,
+            k_data_ptrs=torch.tensor([t.data_ptr() for t in k], dtype=torch.uint64),
+            v_data_ptrs=torch.tensor([t.data_ptr() for t in v], dtype=torch.uint64),
+        ),
+        page_size=page_size,
+        head_num=heads,
+        head_dim=dim,
+        v_head_dim=dim,
+        dtype=torch.uint8,
+        device=torch.device("cpu"),
+        scales=KVScaleBuffers(
+            k=scales(),
+            v=scales(),
+            layout=KVScaleLayout.NVFP4,
+            native_k=native_scales() if native else (),
+            native_v=native_scales() if native else (),
+        ),
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("native", [False, True])
+def test_explicit_layout_selects_fp4_and_payload_view_preserves_allocations(native):
+    source = info(native=native)
+    assert mha.get_mha_host_pool_cls(source) is mha_fp4.MHATokenToKVPoolFP4Host
+    plain = msgspec.structs.replace(source, scales=None)
+    assert mha.get_mha_host_pool_cls(plain) is MHATokenToKVPoolHost
+    payload = mha_fp4.nvfp4_payload_info(source)
+    assert payload.buffers is source.buffers
+    assert payload.head_dim == payload.v_head_dim == source.head_dim // 2
+    assert payload.dtype == torch.uint8 and payload.scales is None
+    assert source.scales is not None and source.head_dim == 64
+
+
+def test_prebudget_staging_uses_packed_byte_width_and_reuses_existing_storage():
+    source = info()
+    with (
+        patch.object(mha, "_is_cuda", True),
+        patch.object(mha, "can_use_write_back_jit_kernel", return_value=True),
+    ):
+        staging = mha.prepare_mha_write_back_staging(
+            source, layer_num=4, page_size=16, page_capacity=2
+        )
+        assert all(t.shape == (32, 4, 2, 32) for t in staging)
+        again = mha.prepare_mha_write_back_staging(
+            source, layer_num=4, page_size=16, page_capacity=2, staging=staging
+        )
+    assert again is staging
+
+
+def make_constructor(source, drafts=(), **kwargs):
+    return mha_fp4.MHATokenToKVPoolFP4Host(
+        source,
+        2,
+        0,
+        16,
+        "page_first",
+        pin_memory=False,
+        device_capacity_tokens=48,
+        start_layer=5,
+        end_layer=7,
+        draft_buffer_infos=drafts,
+        **kwargs,
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("native", [False, True])
+def test_constructor_uses_new_descriptor_api_and_keeps_two_distinct_drafts(native):
+    target, draft0, draft1 = info(native=native), info(1, native), info(1, native)
+    calls = []
+
+    def parent_init(host, payload, *args, **kwargs):
+        calls.append((payload, kwargs))
+        host.can_use_jit = host.can_use_write_back_jit = True
+
+    with (
+        patch.object(MHATokenToKVPoolHost, "__init__", new=parent_init),
+        patch.object(mha_fp4.MHATokenToKVPoolFP4Host, "_init_scale_buffers"),
+        patch.object(mha_fp4, "can_use_write_back_jit_kernel", return_value=True),
+    ):
+        host = make_constructor(target, (draft0, draft1))
+    payload, kwargs = calls[0]
+    assert payload.buffers is target.buffers and payload.scales is None
+    assert kwargs["start_layer"] == 5 and kwargs["end_layer"] == 7
+    assert kwargs["draft_buffer_infos"][0].buffers is draft0.buffers
+    assert kwargs["draft_buffer_infos"][1].buffers is draft1.buffers
+    assert host._scale_dev_k_scale_buffer == [
+        *target.scales.k,
+        *draft0.scales.k,
+        *draft1.scales.k,
+    ]
+    assert len(host._scale_names) == (4 if native else 2)
+    if native:
+        assert host._scale_dev_native_v_scale_buffer[-2] is draft0.scales.native_v[0]
+        assert host._scale_dev_native_v_scale_buffer[-1] is draft1.scales.native_v[0]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "bad",
+    [
+        "layout",
+        "missing_native_v",
+        "wrong_native_shape",
+        "partial_payload",
+        "wrong_payload_width",
+        "draft_page",
+        "draft_layouts",
+        "multi_layer_draft",
+    ],

+def test_invalid_descriptor_fails_before_host_allocation(bad):
+    target, drafts = info(), (info(1),)
+    if bad == "layout":
+        target = msgspec.structs.replace(
+            target,
+            scales=msgspec.structs.replace(target.scales, layout=KVScaleLayout.TOKEN),
+        )
+    elif bad == "missing_native_v":
+        target = msgspec.structs.replace(
+            target, scales=msgspec.structs.replace(target.scales, native_v=())
+        )
+    elif bad == "wrong_native_shape":
+        target = msgspec.structs.replace(
+            target,
+            scales=msgspec.structs.replace(
+                target.scales,
+                native_k=(torch.ones(2, 2, 16, 4, dtype=torch.uint8),) * 2,
+            ),
+        )
+    elif bad in ("partial_payload", "wrong_payload_width"):
+        replacement = tuple(
+            t[:-1] if bad == "partial_payload" else t[..., :-1].contiguous()
+            for t in target.buffers.k
+        )
+        target = msgspec.structs.replace(
+            target, buffers=msgspec.structs.replace(target.buffers, k=replacement)
+        )
+    elif bad == "draft_page":
+        drafts = (info(1, page_size=32),)
+    elif bad == "draft_layouts":
+        drafts = (info(1, native=False),)
+    else:
+        drafts = (info(2),)
+    with patch.object(MHATokenToKVPoolHost, "__init__") as allocated:
+        with pytest.raises((ValueError, NotImplementedError)):
+            make_constructor(target, drafts)
+        allocated.assert_not_called()

+def transfer_host():
+    host = object.__new__(mha_fp4.MHATokenToKVPoolFP4Host)
+    host.page_size, host.page_num, host.target_layer_num, host.layer_num = 4, 4, 2, 4
+    host._scale_names = [
+        "k_scale_buffer",
+        "v_scale_buffer",
+        "native_k_scale_buffer",
+        "native_v_scale_buffer",
+    ]
+    host._scale_page_bytes = {name: 8 for name in host._scale_names}
+    for kind, name in enumerate(host._scale_names):
+        rows = [
+            torch.full((4, 8), 20 * kind + layer + 1, dtype=torch.uint8)
+            for layer in range(4)
+        ]
+        backing = torch.zeros(4, 4, 8, dtype=torch.uint8)
+        setattr(host, f"_scale_rows_{name}", rows)
+        setattr(host, f"_scale_host_{name}", backing)
+        setattr(host, f"_scale_host_layers_{name}", list(backing.transpose(0, 1)))
+        setattr(
+            host,
+            f"_scale_ptrs_{name}",
+            torch.tensor([row.data_ptr() for row in rows], dtype=torch.uint64),
+        )
+        setattr(host, f"_scale_staging_{name}", torch.empty(4, 4, 8, dtype=torch.uint8))
+    return host
+
+
+def test_target_and_two_packed_drafts_restore_every_scale_layout_independently():
+    host = transfer_host()
+    registry = {
+        tuple(getattr(host, f"_scale_ptrs_{name}").tolist()): getattr(
+            host, f"_scale_rows_{name}"
+        )
+        for name in host._scale_names
+    }
+    expected = {
+        name: [row[1:3].clone() for row in getattr(host, f"_scale_rows_{name}")]
+        for name in host._scale_names
+    }
+
+    def backup(**kw):
+        for layer, row in enumerate(registry[tuple(kw["ptr_src"].tolist())]):
+            kw["dst"][kw["dst_indices"], layer] = row[kw["src_indices"]]
+
+    def restore(**kw):
+        kw["cache_dst"][kw["indices_dst"]] = kw["cache_src"][kw["indices_src"]]
+
+    device_indices = torch.arange(4, 12)
+    host_indices = torch.cat((torch.arange(12, 16), torch.arange(0, 4)))
+    with (
+        patch.object(
+            MHATokenToKVPoolHost, "backup_from_device_all_layer"
+        ) as payload_backup,
+        patch.object(MHATokenToKVPoolHost, "load_to_device_per_layer") as payload_load,
+        patch.object(
+            mha_fp4,
+            "jit_transfer_hicache_all_layer_mla_staged_lf_pf",
+            side_effect=backup,
+        ),
+        patch.object(
+            mha_fp4, "jit_transfer_hicache_one_layer_mla", side_effect=restore
+        ),
+    ):
+        host.backup_from_device_all_layer(
+            object(), host_indices, device_indices, "kernel"
+        )
+        for name in host._scale_names:
+            for row in getattr(host, f"_scale_rows_{name}"):
+                row.zero_()
+        for layer in (2, 0, 3, 1):
+            host.load_to_device_per_layer(
+                object(),
+                host_indices,
+                device_indices,
+                layer,
+                "kernel",
+                is_draft=layer >= 2,
+            )
+        assert payload_backup.call_count == 1 and payload_load.call_count == 4
+    for name in host._scale_names:
+        for layer, row in enumerate(getattr(host, f"_scale_rows_{name}")):
+            assert torch.equal(row[1:3], expected[name][layer])
+            assert torch.count_nonzero(row[0]) == torch.count_nonzero(row[3]) == 0
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("direction", ["backup", "load"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "host_count,device_count,backend",
+    [(3, 3, "kernel"), (4, 8, "kernel"), (4, 4, "direct")],
+)
+def test_invalid_transfer_is_rejected_before_payload_or_scale_copy(
+    direction, host_count, device_count, backend
+):
+    host = transfer_host()
+    name = (
+        "backup_from_device_all_layer"
+        if direction == "backup"
+        else "load_to_device_per_layer"
+    )
+    with patch.object(MHATokenToKVPoolHost, name) as payload:
+        with pytest.raises((ValueError, NotImplementedError)):
+            args = [object(), torch.arange(host_count), torch.arange(device_count)]
+            if direction == "load":
